faq.question: Is this course suitable for beginners in cloud?
faq.answer: Yes. It introduces core AWS concepts progressively before moving into larger architecture scenarios.

faq.question: Will I work on practical cloud tasks?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum is designed around deployment logic, infrastructure setup, and reviewable outputs.

faq.question: Does this help with solution architect preparation?
faq.answer: It supports that path by strengthening applied cloud understanding and architecture reasoning.

tasks.title: S3 Read-Only IAM Policy
tasks.assignment: Create a secure user policy that grants read-only access to an S3 bucket.
tasks.ai_review: The AI scans the JSON to ensure Allow is only applied to s3:GetObject and that there are no dangerous wildcard admin privileges.

tasks.title: Public + Private Subnet Design
tasks.assignment: Design a VPC with one public subnet and one private subnet.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks the routing tables to ensure the private subnet does not have a direct Internet Gateway attached.

tasks.title: Lambda + API Gateway Launch
tasks.assignment: Deploy a simple AWS Lambda function connected to an API Gateway.
tasks.ai_review: The AI pings the URL and expects a specific JSON response within a 2-second timeout window.

tasks.title: Load Balancer Architecture
tasks.assignment: Configure a load balancer across two server instances.
tasks.ai_review: The AI reads the documentation to verify the inclusion of Health Checks and Auto-Scaling Groups.

tasks.title: Secure AWS Migration IaC
tasks.assignment: Submit the complete Terraform infrastructure code to migrate a legacy application into a highly secure, auto-scaling AWS environment.
tasks.ai_review: The AI performs a strict security and cost-optimization audit on the code, failing immediately if port 22 SSH is left open to the public internet.
